item.title: 🇷🇺 On September 23, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and US Secretary of State Marco Rubio
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇺🇸 On September 23, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and US Secretary of State Marco Rubio held a meeting in New York on the sidelines of the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly . They held an in-depth exchange of views on a wide range of bilateral and international issues , building on recent contacts at the highest level. Discussing the Ukraine conflict resolution, Russia’s Foreign Minister drew attention to the close coordination between the Kiev regime and its European sponsors . They examined in detail Kiev’s destructive actions , including deliberate strikes against civilians and cross-border infrastructure , which destabilise global energy markets. The Russian Side reaffirmed its unconditional commitment to achieving the goals of the special military operation , including through a political and diplomatic settlement of the conflict that addresses its root causes. International and regional issues discussed included the situation in the Middle East, the South Caucasus, Latin America and the Caribbean, as well as efforts to counter illegitimate practices by certain multilateral institutions in the field of international law. They also reviewed preparations for the #G20 events scheduled before the end of the year. International and regional issues discussed

🎙
Interview
by Director of the Russian Foreign Ministry’s Department of International Organisations Kirill Logvinov with
TASS news agency
(September 23, 2026)
Key points
:
• The schedule of events that members of the Russian delegation will attend on the sidelines of
the #UNGA High-Level Week
will be
subject to change
until the last moment,
as invitations are still coming in.
•
Sergey Lavrov
already has a busy schedule of bilateral meetings
, primarily with representatives of friendly countries, as well as other major global players.
• Sergey Lavrov is scheduled to address
the General Debate
of the 81st Session of the UNGA
on
Saturday, September 26
. That same day, the Head of the Russian delegation will hold his
traditional
press conference
to conclude his visit to New York.
•
Dialogue with the US on removing irritants in bilateral relations
, including restrictions on staff at Russia’s Permanent Mission to the UN,
continues
.
❗️
Russia's Deputy Foreign Minister
Alexander Alimov
, who oversees UN affairs,
has not been issued a visa
. Failure to issue a visa constitutes
a serious violation of US obligations
as the host country of the UN Headquarters.
• Russia continues to press for proceedings to be initiated over the
ongoing US violations of its obligations as the host country of the UN Headquarters
. This is not a demand of our own, but a specific requirement reiterated year after year in the relevant UNGA resolutions.
• Regrettably, the current UN Secretary-General has consistently
evaded implementing these resolutions
and the relevant provisions of
the 1947 UN Headquarters Agreement
. Under Guterres,
the UN Secretariat has effectively admitted its inability to fulfil its duty
to safeguard normal working conditions for permanent missions to the UN.
•
We will, of course, continue to insist that this issue be resolved as soon as possible
. We expect
the next Secretary-General
to initiate arbitration proceedings and, more broadly, to discharge his duties conscientiously and in full accordance with the UN Charter. We would not want to hear the future head of the Secretariat resort to Guterres-style excuses:
“We could, but why bother”
⁉️
• Guterres’ tenure as UN Secretary-General will be remembered for
repeatedly overstepping his mandate
and
departing from the fundamental norms and principles
of
the UN Charter
, which the Secretary-General is called upon to uphold. This has been reflected in politically biased statements, actions taken without consulting member states, and reliance on decisions that lack the broadest possible support.
•
Ultimately,
Guterres’ actions have seriously undermined trust in the UN
. These failings have been most blatant in the context of the Ukraine crisis.
• These issues will also be raised at
the UN Security Council meeting on the situation in Ukraine on September 23
. This will provide Russia's Foreign Minister
Sergey Lavrov
with another opportunity
to explain in detail the goals and objectives of
the special military operation
, including ensuring that the rights of Russians and Russian-speaking people in Ukraine are respected.
•
We have plenty to say to those in the West who support Kiev with money and weapons
, and to UN Secretariat officials who seek to “prioritise” certain principles of
the UN Charter
over others. In the presence of delegations from our allies in the anti-Hitler coalition, we will highlight
the ongoing Nazification of Ukraine
.

item.title: : Government of the Russian Federation Ahead of the 12th St Petersburg International United Cultures Forum
item.description: Government of the Russian Federation : 🎙 Ahead of the 12th St Petersburg International United Cultures Forum , Russia's Deputy Prime Minister Tatyana Golikova, who chairs the Forum’s organising committee, gave an interview to TASS Director General Andrey Kondrashov. 📺 Full video (in Russian) Tatyana Golikova noted considerable interest in the forum : representatives of 70 countries are expected to attend, with 44 official foreign delegations confirmed. Around 2,500 delegates will attend the main programme, while registrations for the forum’s first-ever youth programme are approaching 1,500 . Speaking about international participation, Tatyana Golikova noted that representatives would also be coming from countries Russia designates as unfriendly . 💬 Russia's Deputy Prime Minister Tatyana Golikova: If we are talking about a thaw in relations, we can see that attempts to cancel Russian culture and isolate our country have clearly failed. As for our forum, after 2022 we reassessed the approaches we had followed before the pandemic and even changed its name to reflect Russia’s unifying role as a spiritual and cultural guide and a champion of traditional values. *** The 12th St Petersburg International United Cultures Forum will take place in St Petersburg on September 24-26, 2026. Its main theme is “United Cultures – Shared Values”.

item.title: : Federation Council of the Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation On September 22, Federation Council Speaker
item.description: Federation Council of the Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation : 🇷🇺 🇿🇼 On September 22, Federation Council Speaker Valentina Matviyenko met with President of the Senate of Zimbabwe Mabel Chinomona . Russia's Federation Council Speaker thanked Zimbabwean parliamentarians for monitoring the State Duma elections . 💬 Valentina Matviyenko noted that the traditionally friendly relations between Russia and Zimbabwe date back to Zimbabwe’s struggle for independence : It is gratifying that Zimbabwe remembers the support our country provided during its difficult struggle for national liberation. We stand ready to continue working closely together to combat neocolonialism . 💬 Russia's Federation Council Speaker emphasised that our countries share common views on the contemporary world order: We oppose interference in the affairs of sovereign states and uphold the leading role of the UN and the primacy of international law. #RussiaZimbabwe

Kiev sought to disrupt voting in the new regions
– the Zaporozhye and Kherson regions, as well as the Lugansk and Donetsk People’s Republics – by attacking polling sites.

ustained serious damage

at a school in Prishib, Zaporozhye Region.
On September 20, the main voting day, Ukrainian armed groups launched their largest attack on civilian targets
.
According to Russia’s Defence Ministry
,
1,951 enemy attack drones and nine cruise missiles
heading towards Moscow and the Moscow Region were destroyed over the course of the day. The attacks resulted in
deaths and injuries
, as well as damage to homes, industrial facilities and logistics infrastructure.
Over the past week
, the highest numbers of civilian casualties from Ukrainian attacks were recorded in
the Belgorod Region, the Donetsk and Lugansk People’s Republics, and the Zaporozhye, Kherson, Moscow and Rostov regions
.
On September 14-20
, attacks by Ukrainian Nazis resulted in
379 civilian casualties: 338 people were injured, including 18 minors, and 41 were killed, including four children.
In total, Ukrainian armed formations fired
at least 8,889 munitions

the seven days
–

item.title: : Government of the Russian Federation On September 22, ahead of the XII St Petersburg International United Cultures Forum
item.description: Government of the Russian Federation : On September 22, ahead of the XII St Petersburg International United Cultures Forum , Culture Minister Olga Lyubimova met with her counterparts from the DPRK and Thailand. 🇷🇺 🇰🇵 During her meeting with DPRK Culture Minister, Comrade Hyon Un-chol , Olga Lyubimova discussed cooperation in filmmaking and exchanges between museums. The ministers also reviewed cultural cooperation in 2025, including the participation of Russian performing arts groups in the April Spring Friendship Art Festival in Pyongyang. 🇷🇺 🇹🇭 Olga Lyubimova’s meeting with Thailand's Culture Minister Sabida Thaised focused on the flagship international cultural project Russian Seasons , which is currently enjoying a successful run in the Kingdom. Another key topic was preparations to celebrate the 130th anniversary of diplomatic relations between Russia and Thailand in 2027. #RussiaDPRK #RussiaThailand
